review_capacity.rationale: The pipeline is not bottlenecked by review capacity (0 items awaiting review). It is bottlenecked by the cognitive gap: 1,270 items (50%) at Remember/Understand level need to be upgraded to Analyze/Evaluate to meet CAQS targets. This requires content design work (stem rewrites, distractor engineering), not just review. Additionally, 202 items in Sections E+F remain uncertified because they are Archived DL-012 clones that need replacement authoring.
